bio: Antonio Sacco, also recorded as Antonius, married Anna Villella on 7 May 1746; the marriage entry notes that the groom came from Pittarella, a hamlet of Pedivigliano in the Savuto valley. Family records give his father as Carmine Sacco and his birth as January 1729 at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. An Antonio Sacco was indeed baptized at San Mango on 26 January 1729, but that child's parents were Gioacchino Sacco and Mattea Pagliuso, and since the bridegroom of 1746 came from Pittarella, the baptism may belong to a different Antonio. His origins therefore remain uncertain.

conflicts.assessment: Unresolved: either the tree's Carmine comes from Pittarella records, or the 1729 San Mango baptism is his and the father is Gioacchino.
